format: KBL2: u32 count; per building varint points, u8 kind, varint height (dm), u8 roof (0 by shape, 1 pitched, 2 flat), u16 x, y of the first corner ((metres from the tile's corner) + 50) * 8, then zigzag varint steps (eighths of a metre)

left_out.basis: docs/app-regions.json bboxes: those regions draw their own buildings

heights.inferred_basis: OSM building kind and footprint area (a house 6.5 m, a garage 3.2 m, a block of flats 10.5 m)

role: Mapped footprints, heights mostly inferred: the landscape's towns beyond the built regions, not survey truth
